Aerie.name: Aerie
Aerie.description: Each installed Raven Black ICE destroys Programs instead of derezzing.

Bottle Dynamo.name: Bottle Dynamo
Bottle Dynamo.description: A dynamo on your bike's wheel for converting mechanical energy into electricity. Charges a battery pack (such as for weapons) in one hour.

Bulletproof Glass.name: Panzerglas
Bulletproof Glass.description:
Enclosure glass gains 7 HP.

Bike first requires the Enclosure upgrade to install this upgrade.

Bushido Accelerator.name: Bushido Accelerator
Bushido Accelerator.description: +3 Speed to all installed Killer Black ICE.

Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Kaltwetter-Jackenfutter
Cold-Weather Jacket Lining.description: Verbesserung für alle Jacken-Modegegenstände. Schützt den Träger vor Umwelteinflüssen durch kalte Temperaturen (CP:R S. 180).

Combat Recorder.name: Combat Recorder
Combat Recorder.description:
Real-world Combat data is invaluable for Black ICE development.

If another Netrunner in the same NET Architecture fails a Death Save, the last 5 minutes of non-self incriminating Netrun combat data is saved to the Cyberdeck. Recordings can be sold for 50eb.

Cycle Armor.name: Cycle Armor
Cycle Armor.description:
Bicycle Armored with 7 PS.

Bike first requires the Reinforced Frame upgrade to install this upgrade.

Defense Sequencer.name: Defense Sequencer
Defense Sequencer.description: If an active Armor Program is derezzed or destroyed, Defense Sequencer activates a yet-unused copy of Armor Program at the start of the Netrunner’s turn.

Electric Pedal Assist.name: Electric Pedal Assist
Electric Pedal Assist.description:
Electric motorised system helping to pedal, increasing speed, lowering tiredness.

Up to next BODY level speed narrative speed, or +5MPH (8KPH) if rider is already at the top tier.

Rider get +4 bonus to Endurance Checks when riding.

Enclosure.name: Enclosure
Enclosure.description:
The bike becomes a trike with a covering body of fiberglass and plastic.

Can't install this Upgrade with the Folding Frame upgrade.

Extended Seat.name: Extended Seat
Extended Seat.description: An elongated saddle, gaining a seat for a passenger.

Feline Instinct.name: Feline Instinct
Feline Instinct.description: If an installed Sabertooth Black ICE destroys a program, that Sabertooth deals an extra 1d6 of damage on each subsequent attack for the duration of the Netrun.

Folding Frame.name: Folding Frame
Folding Frame.description:
You can now fold your bike to the size of a large suitcase for easier transport and storage.

Can't install this Upgrade with Enclosure, Reinforced Frame, or Smuggling Compartment upgrades.

Gun Mount.name: Gun Mount
Gun Mount.description:
A system to attach an Assault Rifle, a Heavy SMG or a Shotgun on the handlebars, along with a firing button.

Shoots only forwards.

Mounting and detaching requires one Action.

Hangry Hangry Dragon.name: Hangry Hangry Dragon
Hangry Hangry Dragon.description: Everytime an installed Dragon Black ICE destroys a Program it regains full REZ.

Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.name: Hitzewetter-Jackenfutter
Hot-Weather Jacket Lining.description:
Verbesserung für jeden Jacken-Modegegenstand. Schützt den Träger vor Umwelteinflüssen durch heiße Temperaturen (CP:R S. 180).

Hitzewellen verdoppelt alle Abzüge durch schwere Rüstung (NCW S. 5). Beispielsweise erhält ein Träger von einem Mittelschwerem Panzeranzug während einer Hitzewelle -4 auf BEW, GES und REF. Hitzewetter-Jackenfutter senkt jeden dieser Abzüge um 1.

Neon Lightning.name: Neon Lightning
Neon Lightning.description:
Fiber-optic lights on bike's frame and wheels.

Considered as a Light Tattoo when on or near the bike (gaining +2 Wardrobe & Style bonus)

Perfume Shoppe.name: Perfume Shoppe
Perfume Shoppe.description: Skunk Black ICE will only take 1 option slot to install.

Reinforced Frame.name: Reinforced Frame
Reinforced Frame.description:
Bike is now more resistant: +5 SDP and rider can be BODY 11 or more.

Can't install this Upgrade with Folding Frame Upgrade.

Security System.name: Security System
Security System.description:
Linked with your Agent to electrify your bike. A thief must resist DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs or unhand the bike.

Bike is registered with a Nano-VIN.

Smithy.name: Smithy
Smithy.description:
Be prepared for anything. Enter a NET Architecture full of Black ICE and you don’t have have a Sword Program handy? Swap out your useless Banhammer with the press of a button.

Use Meat Action to change any and all installed Sword Programs into Banhammer Programs or vice versa.

Smuggling Compartment.name: Smuggling Compartment
Smuggling Compartment.description:
Adds a small hidden storage space in the frame.

1 inch x 6 inches (2.54cm x 15.24cm)

DV17 Conceal/Reveal Object check to discover.

Can't install this Upgrade with Folding Frame.

Snaketrap.name: Snaketrap
Snaketrap.description: Protects against the first attack (Asp, Raven, or Poison Flatline effects) that would destroy a random installed Program. This protective effect can be use only once per Netrun even if multiple copies of Snaketrap are installed.

Stunt Frame.name: Stunt Frame
Stunt Frame.description:
The bike loses weight and gains maneuverability.

Rider obtain a +2 bonus to Athletics skill checks when riding and doing maneuvers.

Swamp Mist.name: Swamp Mist
Swamp Mist.description:
Wisp Black ICE deal 2d6 damage instead of 1d6.

Black ICE Program restrictions: Only Wisps can be installed.

Swifty Clean.name: Swifty Clean
Swifty Clean.description: Netrunner can roll Cloak twice in a single NET Action and take the higher roll. Cloak can only be used once per Netrun when Swifty Clean is installed.

Trailer.name: Trailer
Trailer.description:
Hook with a small cargo trailer.

5 feet x 1.5 feet (1.5m x 0.46m).

An action is needed to attach and detach the trailer.

Waterproof Jacket Lining.name: Wasserdichtes Jackenfutter
Waterproof Jacket Lining.description:
Verbesserung für jeden Jacken-Modegegenstand. Ähnelt mechanisch einem Regenschirm und taugt nicht als Taucheranzug.

Schützt vor Säureregen. Säureregen trägt pro Minute 1 SW von aller Rüstung ab (NCW S. 4).

+2 auf Folter/Drogen widerstehen gegen Blutregen. Schwerer Blutregen hat bei Misserfolg die Wirkung einer Flasche mit Biotoxin. (NCW S. 4).
